meanings.en: a fizzy soft drink with a bitter flavour, often mixed with gin
meanings.exampleEn: She ordered a gin and tonic at the bar.
meanings.exampleTr: Barda cin tonik sipariş etti.

meanings.en: something that makes you feel stronger, healthier, or happier
meanings.exampleEn: A walk in the fresh air is a wonderful tonic.
meanings.exampleTr: Temiz havada yürüyüş harika bir canlandırıcıdır.

meanings.en: of the very best standard or grade
meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant uses only top-quality ingredients.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoran yalnızca en kaliteli malzemeleri kullanır.

meanings.en: highest; nearest to the top
meanings.exampleEn: The bird landed on the topmost branch of the tree.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuş ağacın en üstteki dalına kondu.

meanings.en: a state of being inactive, sluggish, or without energy
meanings.exampleEn: The summer heat left everyone in a state of torpor.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaz sıcağı herkesi bir uyuşukluk haline soktu.

meanings.en: easily offended or upset
meanings.exampleEn: He's very touchy about his weight, so don't mention it.
meanings.exampleTr: Kilosu konusunda çok alıngandır, o yüzden bahsetme.

meanings.en: needing to be dealt with carefully; sensitive
meanings.exampleEn: Money can be a touchy subject between friends.
meanings.exampleTr: Para, arkadaşlar arasında hassas bir konu olabilir.

meanings.en: the businesses and services connected with providing travel and holidays
meanings.exampleEn: The tourism industry accounts for a large part of the country's economy.
meanings.exampleTr: Turizm sektörü, ülkenin ekonomisinin büyük bir bölümünü oluşturur.

meanings.en: the part of the economy made up of travel and holiday businesses
meanings.exampleEn: The pandemic hit the tourism sector especially hard.
meanings.exampleTr: Pandemi özellikle turizm sektörünü ağır vurdu.

meanings.en: (of hair) untidy, in a messy or ruffled way
meanings.exampleEn: He ran his hand through his tousled hair.
meanings.exampleTr: Elini dağınık saçlarının arasından geçirdi.

meanings.en: to pull a vehicle or boat along behind another vehicle using a rope or chain
meanings.exampleEn: The truck had to tow the broken-down car to the garage.
meanings.exampleTr: Kamyon, arızalı arabayı tamirhaneye çekmek zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: in the direction of someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She walked toward the door without saying a word.
meanings.exampleTr: Tek kelime etmeden kapıya doğru yürüdü.

meanings.en: in relation to someone or something; regarding
meanings.exampleEn: His attitude toward his colleagues has improved.
meanings.exampleTr: İş arkadaşlarına karşı tutumu düzeldi.

meanings.en: a very tall building divided into flats or offices
meanings.exampleEn: They live on the tenth floor of a tower block.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir apartman bloğunun onuncu katında yaşıyorlar.

meanings.en: a person who lives in a town
meanings.exampleEn: Every townsperson gathered in the square for the festival.
meanings.exampleTr: Her kasabalı, festival için meydanda toplandı.

meanings.en: a device or program used to follow the movement or progress of something
meanings.exampleEn: She uses a fitness tracker to count her daily steps.
meanings.exampleTr: Günlük adımlarını saymak için bir fitness takip cihazı kullanıyor.

meanings.en: a person who follows the tracks of animals or people
meanings.exampleEn: The tracker led the hunters through the dense forest.
meanings.exampleTr: İz süren kişi, avcıları sık ormandan geçirdi.

meanings.en: a school that follows conventional teaching methods rather than modern or alternative ones
meanings.exampleEn: Some parents prefer a traditional school with strict discipline.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazı ebeveynler, sıkı disiplinli geleneksel bir okulu tercih eder.

meanings.en: the belief in and support for established customs and traditions
meanings.exampleEn: His traditionalism made him resist any change in the company.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelenekçiliği, şirketteki her türlü değişime direnmesine neden oldu.

meanings.en: the illegal buying and selling of goods, drugs, or people
meanings.exampleEn: The police arrested several people involved in drug trafficking.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis, uyuşturucu kaçakçılığına karışan birkaç kişiyi tutukladı.

meanings.en: a person who is the first to do something and shows a way for others to follow
meanings.exampleEn: She was a trailblazer for women in the technology sector.
meanings.exampleTr: Teknoloji sektöründe kadınlar için bir öncüydü.

meanings.en: a state of calm and peace
meanings.exampleEn: She enjoyed the tranquility of the early morning garden.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabahın erken saatlerindeki bahçenin dinginliğinin tadını çıkardı.

meanings.en: a drug used to make a person or animal calm or unconscious
meanings.exampleEn: The vet gave the frightened dog a tranquilizer.
meanings.exampleTr: Veteriner, korkmuş köpeğe bir sakinleştirici verdi.

meanings.en: a peaceful, calm state (British spelling of tranquility)
meanings.exampleEn: The countryside offered a sense of tranquillity she had missed.
meanings.exampleTr: Kırsal, özlediği bir dinginlik hissi sunuyordu.

meanings.en: to change completely into a different form or state
meanings.exampleEn: The caterpillar will transform into a butterfly.
meanings.exampleTr: Tırtıl bir kelebeğe dönüşecek.

meanings.en: the state of lasting only for a short time
meanings.exampleEn: The poem reflects on the transience of youth and beauty.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiir, gençliğin ve güzelliğin geçiciliği üzerine düşünür.

meanings.en: able to be passed from one person, animal, or thing to another
meanings.exampleEn: The virus is highly transmissible through the air.
meanings.exampleTr: Virüs hava yoluyla oldukça bulaşabilir.

meanings.en: a piece of equipment that sends out radio or television signals
meanings.exampleEn: The radio transmitter broadcasts to the whole region.
meanings.exampleTr: Radyo vericisi tüm bölgeye yayın yapar.

meanings.en: a large vehicle used for carrying goods, cars, or other heavy things
meanings.exampleEn: A car transporter delivered the new vehicles to the dealership.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir araç nakliye aracı, yeni araçları bayiye teslim etti.

meanings.en: a business that arranges travel and holidays for people
meanings.exampleEn: We booked our flights through a travel agency.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçak biletlerimizi bir seyahat acentesi aracılığıyla ayırttık.

meanings.en: not able to be trusted; likely to betray someone
meanings.exampleEn: His treacherous friend revealed all his secrets.
meanings.exampleTr: Hain arkadaşı tüm sırlarını açığa çıkardı.

meanings.en: dangerous, especially when it seems safe
meanings.exampleEn: The icy roads were treacherous that night.
meanings.exampleTr: O gece buzlu yollar tehlikeliydi.

meanings.en: behaviour that betrays trust; disloyalty
meanings.exampleEn: He could never forgive the treachery of his closest ally.
meanings.exampleTr: En yakın müttefikinin ihanetini asla affedemedi.

meanings.en: the crime of betraying one's country, especially by helping its enemies
meanings.exampleEn: He was charged with treason for selling state secrets.
meanings.exampleTr: Devlet sırlarını sattığı için vatana ihanetle suçlandı.

meanings.en: involving the crime of betraying one's country
meanings.exampleEn: His treasonous actions endangered the entire nation.
meanings.exampleTr: Vatana ihanet niteliğindeki eylemleri tüm ulusu tehlikeye attı.

meanings.tr: tekrar tedavi etmek, yeniden işlem yapmak
meanings.en: to give medical care or apply a process to something once more
meanings.exampleEn: If the infection returns, the doctor will treat it again.
meanings.exampleTr: Enfeksiyon geri gelirse, doktor onu tekrar tedavi edecek.

meanings.en: able to be cured or helped with medical care
meanings.exampleEn: Fortunately, the disease is easily treatable if caught early.
meanings.exampleTr: Neyse ki, erken teşhis edilirse hastalık kolayca tedavi edilebilir.

meanings.en: a long, formal piece of writing that deals with a subject thoroughly
meanings.exampleEn: He wrote a lengthy treatise on political philosophy.
meanings.exampleTr: Siyaset felsefesi üzerine uzun bir inceleme yazdı.

meanings.tr: uzun ve zorlu yürüyüş yapan kişi
meanings.en: a person who goes on a long, difficult journey on foot, especially in the mountains
meanings.exampleEn: Every trekker needs strong boots for the mountain trail.
meanings.exampleTr: Her yürüyüşçünün dağ patikası için sağlam botlara ihtiyacı vardır.

meanings.en: to enter someone's land or property without permission
meanings.exampleEn: The sign warned people not to trespass on the farm.
meanings.exampleTr: Tabela, insanları çiftliğe izinsiz girmemeleri konusunda uyarıyordu.

meanings.en: a state of great trouble or suffering; a cause of distress
meanings.exampleEn: They shared the trials and tribulations of raising a family.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir aile büyütmenin sıkıntılarını ve çilelerini paylaştılar.

meanings.en: the use of dishonest tricks to deceive someone
meanings.exampleEn: He won the contract through trickery rather than skill.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşmeyi beceriyle değil hileyle kazandı.

meanings.en: to flow slowly in a thin stream or in drops
meanings.exampleEn: Water began to trickle down the window pane.
meanings.exampleTr: Su, pencere camından aşağı ince ince akmaya başladı.

meanings.en: to move or arrive slowly in small numbers or amounts
meanings.exampleEn: News of the results trickled in throughout the evening.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonuçların haberleri akşam boyunca azar azar geldi.

meanings.en: something that is unimportant; the quality of being of little importance
meanings.exampleEn: They argued over the triviality of who should wash the dishes.
meanings.exampleTr: Bulaşıkları kimin yıkayacağı gibi önemsiz bir konu üzerine tartıştılar.

meanings.en: a solemn promise, especially a pledge to marry someone (archaic)
meanings.exampleEn: In the old ceremony, they pledged their troth to each other.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski törende, birbirlerine sadakat sözü verdiler.

meanings.en: the lowest point in an economic cycle or a period of low activity
meanings.exampleEn: The economy reached a trough before beginning to recover.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekonomi, toparlanmaya başlamadan önce en dip noktasına ulaştı.

meanings.en: a long, narrow open container that animals eat or drink from
meanings.exampleEn: The horses gathered around the water trough.
meanings.exampleTr: Atlar su yalağının etrafında toplandı.

meanings.en: a group of performers such as actors, dancers, or singers who work together
meanings.exampleEn: The dance troupe performed at theatres across the country.
meanings.exampleTr: Dans topluluğu ülke genelindeki tiyatrolarda sahne aldı.

meanings.en: the practice of staying away from school without permission
meanings.exampleEn: The school introduced new measures to reduce truancy.
meanings.exampleTr: Okul, devamsızlığı azaltmak için yeni önlemler getirdi.

meanings.en: tending to trust others readily; not suspicious
meanings.exampleEn: The child gave a trustful smile to the stranger.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuk, yabancıya güven dolu bir gülümseme verdi.

meanings.en: a pain in the stomach (informal, often used by or with children)
meanings.exampleEn: The little boy had a tummyache after eating too much cake.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük çocuk çok fazla kek yedikten sonra karın ağrısı çekti.
